desc: Set properties on a code channel.

token.desc: Authentication token bearing the `code_channels:manage` scope. Must be a granular bot token.

channel_id.desc: ID of the code channel to update.

title.desc: New display title for the agent session.

status.desc: New status for the agent session.

code_channel.desc: Code channel properties to set. Only provided fields are updated.

base_branch.desc: Base branch the working branch was created from.

pr_status.desc: Status of the pull request (e.g. open, merged, closed).

ci_url.desc: URL to the CI pipeline run.

ci_state.desc: State of the CI pipeline (e.g. pending, success, failure).

file_paths.desc: List of file paths relevant to this session.

context_bar_items.desc: Configurable items to display in the channel context bar. A maximum of 5 items will be applied; any beyond that will be silently truncated and a warning returned.

summary_message.desc: Points to the current summary message for this code channel. Must reference a message within this channel. When the channel is archived with a summary_message_ts, this property is also set to record where the summary lives so clients can fetch it.

message_ts.desc: Timestamp of the summary message in the code channel.

thread_ts.desc: Thread timestamp if the summary message is a thread reply. Clients need this to fetch the message via conversations.replies.

agent_resource.desc: Agent resource properties to set. Only provided fields are updated.

title.desc: Display title of the external resource.

channel_id.desc: The encoded ID of the updated code channel.

too_many_context_bar_items.desc: More than 5 context bar items were provided. Only the first 5 were applied.

summary_message_not_found.desc: The message_ts provided in summary_message does not correspond to a message in this channel. The summary_message field was ignored.

channel_not_found.desc: The specified channel_id does not correspond to a valid channel.

not_agent_channel.desc: The specified channel is not a code channel.

not_authorized.desc: The caller is not an authorized agent bot for this channel.

invalid_status.desc: Value passed for `status` was not a valid agent session status.

no_properties_provided.desc: At least one property field must be provided.
